marks.label: The 12 cranial nerves · Built from what you gave me | 12 stops: Olfactory, Optic, Oculomotor, Trochlear…
1 · Olfactory | The cat's sniff drifts toward the bird's watchful gaze.
2 · Optic | The bird's view turns to the dog's hat‑tied eyes.
3 · Oculomotor | The dog spins an umbrella, guiding the next turn.
4 · Trochlear | The spinning umbrella drops three balls onto a tree.
5 · Trigeminal | One ball rolls away as a dog pulls a drop.
6 · Abducens | The dog’s pull brightens a sun‑smiling face.
7 · Facial | The sun’s glow lifts a bird onto a cloud.
8 · Vestibulocochlear | The bird’s song drips from a fountain’s drop.
9 · Glossopharyngeal | The fountain’s mist guides a dog beneath a tree.
10 · Vagus | The dog’s path leads a person to lift a hat.
11 · Accessory | The lifted hat opens a book for the final tongue.
12 · Hypoglossal | Number 12: Hypoglossal. A person reads a book, tongue moving silently.
